name: codex-usage-monitor
description: A compact macOS monitor for Codex limits and paid-credit usage.

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target node --external electron && bun build src/preload.ts --outfile dist/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.dev: bun run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.package:mac: bun run build && bunx electron-packager . "Codex Monitor" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --icon=assets/codex-monitor.icns --app-bundle-id=com.codexmonitor.app --app-category-type=public.app-category.developer-tools --ignore="^/release($|/)"
scripts.install:mac: bun run package:mac && ditto "release/Codex Monitor-darwin-arm64/Codex Monitor.app" "/Applications/Codex Monitor.app"
